title: SHADOW PRIEST

source.author: Mobalytics-Oli
source.name: Mobalytics WoW Forever · Priest Leveling Guide (Level 1-30)

headline: Damage over time plus Mind Blast and Mind Flay, with a wand to finish: strong wand damage and mana sustain.

build.early: The first 2 points go into Wand Specialization (Discipline), assuming an early quest rewards a wand. If not, skip them and start in Shadow. Mind Blast is learnable at level 5, Mind Flay as early as level 21.

why.Wand Specialization: Big boost to free wand damage.
why.Spirit Tap: Spirit and mana after each kill; pairs with wand finishing.
why.Improved Shadow Word: Pain: Shadow Word: Pain lasts 6 seconds longer.
why.Shadow Focus: Better chance to land Shadow spells.
why.Shadow Reach: +20% range on Shadow spells (30 to 36 yards).
why.Mind Flay: Channeled damage and a slow: a huge power spike.
why.Improved Mind Flay: More damage and range, slightly weaker slow.
why.Vampiric Embrace: Passive healing for you and your party.
why.Shadow Weaving: Stacking Shadow damage bonus on the target.

core.t: Open with it and use on cooldown (8s): your fastest, most bursty cast.
Cast right after Mind Blast and keep it up as needed.
Channel as the target closes the distance.
Apply before combat; it protects against damage and pushback.
Fear enemies away when they reach melee.

items.t: or let the shield absorb at melee range
wand it down at about 20% HP

notes: Visit your class trainer every 2 levels (2, 4, 6, 8, 10 ...) so you do not miss upgrades.
Follow the MP5 rule: mana only regenerates after 5 seconds without casting. Pulling several enemies is possible but hurts your sustain.
Priest spells are mana-intensive: do not overkill with a damage spell when a mob is nearly dead, and consider Psychic Scream instead of re-shielding.
Sustain is a big part of leveling: less drinking means less downtime.
gear: Watch for wand upgrades, especially at low levels: a good wand is your best friend.
Wand finishing combines with Spirit Tap and the MP5 rule to cut downtime.
dungeon_tips: Vampiric Embrace heals your party as you deal Shadow damage.
Eureka! (Gnome) or Berserking (Troll) are good burst windows in PvE.
Power Word: Shield and Psychic Scream keep pushback and incoming damage low.

alliance.note: New Priest race. Eureka! cuts the cost of your next 3 casts and adds 10% damage or healing: the PvE pick.
Will to Survive breaks stuns and Perception counters stealth: the PvP pick.

horde.note: Berserking is a flat 10% cast and attack speed burst; +5% damage to beasts and better combat regeneration. The PvE pick.
Will of the Forsaken (Fear, Sleep, Charm) and Touch of the Grave. The PvP pick.

races.pick: Human for PvP or Gnome for PvE (Alliance); Undead for PvP or Troll for PvE (Horde).

trainers: Visit your class trainer every 2 levels.
